title: Uniform sampling algorithm
statement: The uniform sampling algorithm is the function on Boolean lists obtained by applying the specified loop with step function `sampleStep` to the encoded components of its input and returning the second component of the resulting encoding.
caveat: The meanings of `sampleStep`, the encoding operations, and the loop are not supplied, so their mathematical behavior cannot be stated more explicitly.
